title_as_printed: Hydrate-liquid-vapor equilibrium at temperature T, pressure p, liquid-phase mole fraction of methane xCH4 and carbon dioxide xCO2, and vapor-phase mole fraction of carbon dioxide yCO2 for the system methane + carbon dioxide + water.
pressure_note: not stated beyond 'p /MPa' (equilibrium pressure of the crystallizer, controlled; the text says temperature and pressure were controlled and vapor composition measured to confirm equilibrium); whether it includes water vapour is not stated

value2.what: CO2 mole fraction in liquid water-rich phase

extra_unmapped: yCO2 (equilibrium vapour-phase CO2 mole fraction, measured by GC; binary gas, water in vapour not reported)
notes: Mixed-gas system: each row gives both xCH4 and xCO2 in the same liquid sample (gas mixture CH4+CO2, vapour composition yCO2). Mole fractions are of each gas in the total liquid (water + dissolved gases); gas_basis not_applicable for pure water but the gas phase is a CH4+CO2 mixture. Ranges: T 274.02-280.12 K, p 1.66-4.03 MPa. Standard (k=1) uncertainties: u(T)=0.1 K, u(p)=0.015 MPa, u(yCO2)=0.02, u(xCH4)=0.000040, u(xCO2)=0.00027; expanded (k=2): U(T)=0.2 K, U(p)=0.03 MPa, U(yCO2)=0.04, U(xCH4)=0.000080, U(xCO2)=0.00054 (stated as constants in text).
